title: bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se
body:
Haye abbas... Haye abbas..
{Kulsoom roke kehti thi ummul baneen se
<<MINI>>
Bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se }..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ummeed pyase baccho ki mujhse judi rahe..(2)
wo chahta tha mashk e sakina bachi rahe
yu teer rokta raha apne jabeen se
<<MINI>>
Bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Baba ka zakhm yaad hai gehra tha kis qadar..(2)
aise hi tha do neem mere bawafa ka sar
Haider ki tarha khan tha jaree jabeen se
<<MINI>>
Bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haye..
Ek aankh me tha teer to ek aankh me lau
Khaime ki raah dhundh raha tha wo char soo
Haye, ek gurz ne gira diya..(2)
bekas ko zeen se
<<MINI>>
Bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Rooh e ali ke bayn the haye mera safeer..(2)
sar par bhi gurz, bazu juda, aankh mein bhi teer
badla...
badla mera liya hai mere janasheen se
<<MINI>>
Bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Saqqa haram ka dasht mein bejaan hogaya..(2)
ab marna hussain ko aasan hogaya
ye shor..
ye shor uth raha tha sipah e la'een se
<<MINI>>
Bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ghazi ki maut haal ye zainab ka kar gayi..(2)
lagta tha jaise saniye zahra bhi mar gayi
aise...
aise giri wo jaise gira bhai zeen se
<<MINI>>
Bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Amma mai apne bete ka matam na kar saki
hadd ye hai, qaid hoke mai jab sham ko chali..(2)
baazu..
baazu utha ke choom na payi zameen se
<<MINI>>
Bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Akbar behen ye boli ghazab ki jafa hui..(2)
asghar ke jaisi laash mere bhai ki bachi
Abid ne uske tukde chune hai zameen se
<<MINI>>
Bin bazuon ke utra hai abbas zeen se
<<DIVIDER>>
